resources.string: Let an AI client that holds a token look up contacts and send text and pictures as this account, over a port on this phone or its local network.

Runs inside Douyin and listens on this phone only (127.0.0.1) unless local network access is on. Any app on the phone can reach that port, so every request needs a token: give one only to a client you trust, with no more permissions and chats than it needs.
Listening on port %1$d for this phone and its local networks
From a device on the same network, point the client (Streamable HTTP) at %1$s with the header Authorization: Bearer followed by the token.
This phone has no local network address right now. Join a Wi-Fi network or turn on the hotspot.
Let devices on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot connect. Addresses outside a private network are still turned away.

The server speaks plain HTTP. On a network, whoever can read its traffic can read a token and use it. Turn this on only on a network you trust, and give each token no more permissions and chats than it needs.
Not running. Turn the switch on and restart Douyin. Tokens can be prepared now.
From a computer, run adb forward tcp:%1$d tcp:%1$d, then point the client (Streamable HTTP) at http://127.0.0.1:%1$d/mcp with the header Authorization: Bearer followed by the token.
1024 to 65535. A running server moves to the new port at once.
No tool call since Douyin started.
Kept in memory until Douyin restarts. The text of a message is never recorded.
Sign in to Douyin to create a token.
Which client this token is for
Find and list friends and group chats.
Send text to the chats this token reaches.
Send JPEG and PNG pictures to the chats this token reaches.
Claim earned spark rewards and pet closeness with the friends this token reaches.
Mark every chat read at once, as the message tab menu does. Not bounded by the chosen chats.
Send any IM request as this account, unchecked, and read its response. Not bounded by the chosen chats.
Raw protocol requests work only with “All friends and groups” on, because a request can address any chat.
Marking all chats read works only with “All friends and groups” on, because it marks every chat.
When off, only the chats chosen below.
This token cannot do anything yet: it needs a permission and at least one chat.
The token text in use stops working at once. The new one is shown only once.
“%1$s” stops working at once and cannot be restored.
This is the only time the token is shown. Only its hash is kept.
Give the token a name of up to 64 characters.
Requests per minute must be 1 to 600.
There can be at most 64 tokens.
A token can name at most 2000 chats.
The MCP server is not available: %1$s
